title: Chen Xuan's Testament
next_chapter_hook: From the depths of the ruins came the aura of the demonic army's supreme commander, and the twins of fate officially resonated—the blood connection between Chen Ji and his sister Chen Nian was activated at this moment.

text.content:
The aura of the same origin as the Tianji Record flooded into Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a tide, almost instantly resonating with the Tianji Record Fragment in his body. The corpse that had lain in the coffin for ten thousand years slowly sat up, and the moment those turbid eyes opened, they burst forth with light capable of piercing through the Nine Underworlds.

Chen Ji's entire body froze, instinctively wanting to retreat, only to find his form firmly locked in place by an invisible force.

dialogue.content: (Inner shock) This aura... is identical to the Tianji Record Fragment, yet a thousand, ten thousand times more vast. Could this be the legendary first-generation inheritor—Chen Xuan?

text.content: The face of the corpse in the coffin was identical to the person Chen Ji had seen in the illusion, only bearing the vicissitudes and death of ten thousand years. Yet in the next moment, two clusters of ghostly blue soul fires ignited in the corpse's eye sockets, the withered lips slightly quivering, and an aged yet authoritative voice exploded in Chen Ji's mind—

dialogue.content:
"Descendant of later generations, you have finally arrived."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, the other's voice carrying a complex emotion intertwined with ineffable relief and bitterness.

text.content:
The gaze of Chen Xuan's remnant soul seemed to pierce through all his disguises, clearly seeing the incomplete Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea. After a moment of silence, Chen Xuan's voice sounded again, this time carrying boundless vicissitudes and sorrow—

"Once, I was like you, believing that obtaining the Tianji Record would allow me to pierce through heavenly secrets and control destiny. Little did I know, this was merely a chess game set up by that thing."

dialogue.content:
"That thing?" Chen Ji narrowed his eyes. "What does Senior refer to?"

Chen Xuan's remnant soul let out a cold laugh, the sound full of mockery and unwillingness: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao—do you think the Tianji Record is some ancient treasure, a shortcut to cultivation? It is merely a sickle used by that high-and-mighty Heavenly Dao will to harvest the seeds of destiny from the mortal realm."

text.content: Chen Xuan's remnant soul's voice echoed through the Mental Sea, each word striking like thunderclaps in Chen Ji's heart. He continued: "The holders of the Tianji Record through the ages, seemingly gained the ability to foresee the future, but in truth merely gathered fragments of destiny for the Eye of Heavenly Dao. Every time the power of heavenly secrets is used, it feeds that thing—and the so-called Heavenly Fate Value is merely a shackle it has bound us with."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji forced himself to calm down, his mind racing. If what this elder said was true, then all his actions these past months had been under someone's control.

"Senior, since you knew all this, how did you come to such a state?" Chen Ji asked in a deep voice.

text.content:
Chen Xuan's remnant soul figure trembled slightly, a glimpse of deep-seated hatred flickering in those soul fires: "Back then, I too questioned the Eye of Heavenly Dao like you, then tried to break this shackle. I succeeded—at least in that moment when I thought I had succeeded, I truly touched a breath of freedom."

He paused, his voice becoming low and sorrowful: "Then, it personally slew and sealed me here."

dialogue.content:
Just then, a low rumble suddenly came from the depths of the ruins, the entire space quaking violently. Chen Xuan's remnant soul's expression changed drastically, a hint of anxiety flickering in those soul fires—

"Time is running out. That thing has sensed my aura and is following the trail."

text.content:
Chen Xuan's remnant soul waved his hand, and a stream of light flew from his fingertips, directly entering Chen Ji's Mental Sea. It was a completely black fragment, its surface covered with densely packed patterns, emanating an aura completely opposite to the Tianji Record—destruction, rebellion, defiance.

"This is the shackle fragment I condensed from my entire life's cultivation back then." Chen Xuan's voice became serious and urgent. "The reason the Tianji Record's shackle is unsolvable is that it has completely bound with your soul. But this fragment can tear a gap in your body—a blind spot in that Eye of Heavenly Dao's surveillance."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji reached out to receive that fragment, a scorching force immediately surging from his palm into his limbs and torso. Yet at the same time, a series of cold system notifications rang in his mind—

[Unknown Energy Intrusion Detected]
[Shackle Rules Being Rewritten...]
[Heavenly Fate Value Consumption Mode Changing...]
[Warning: Heavenly Dao Will Gaze Detected]

choice.prompt: Chen Xuan's testament struck like thunder in Chen Ji's heart, the gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Dao sending a chill down his spine. Now he must make a choice—

choices.description: Since the shackle can be broken, the Eye of Heavenly Dao's chess game is not invulnerable. Accept Chen Xuan's legacy and face this so-called Heavenly Dao will head-on.
choices.visible_cost: Endure the backlash of the shackle fragment, strength temporarily impaired
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the shackle fragment, rewrite the Heavenly Fate Value consumption rules
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao will certainly intervene in person
choices.process_label: 继承初代天机录传承者的意志

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath and steadily pressed the fragment into the depths of his Mental Sea. In an instant, intense pain erupted from the depths of his soul, as if something was being violently torn apart.

But he did not retreat; instead, he activated the Tianji Record Fragment, proactively guiding that destructive force to combat the shackle.

Seeing this, Chen Xuan's remnant soul finally showed a satisfied gleam in his eyes: "Good! Worthy of being a Chen family descendant!"

choices.description: Not rushing to accept the inheritance, first use this brief time to extract more about the weaknesses and flaws of the Eye of Heavenly Dao from Chen Xuan.
choices.visible_cost: Consume precious time, possibly missing the optimal moment to fuse with the shackle fragment
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence, increasing the odds for future stratagems
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye may descend at any moment
choices.process_label: 向初代传承者追问天道之眼的弱点

text.content: Chen Ji endured the excruciating pain of his soul being torn apart, yet his expression remained unchanged as he asked: 'Senior, since the Heavenly Eye is so powerful, how did you manage to touch the flaw in the shackles back then?' Chen Xuan was momentarily stunned, then replied with a bitter smile: 'You boy, you're far more composed than I was back then. Fine, since you asked, I'll tell you—the Heavenly Eye is not invincible. It has a fatal weakness.'

choices.description: Everything was too coincidental—could a remnant soul dormant for ten thousand years suddenly appear and bestow a treasure? Chen Ji remained highly suspicious, probing Chen Xuan's true intentions.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity; if Chen Xuan speaks truth, precious time will be wasted
choices.visible_reward: Avoid falling into traps, maintain control over the situation
choices.risk_hint: If Chen Xuan is genuinely benevolent, may lose his trust
choices.process_label: 试探陈玄残魂的真实意图

dialogue.content: Chen Ji stepped back half a pace, his gaze sharpening: 'Senior, ten thousand years are enough for any obsession to dissipate. You left these behind, truly just to pass on your legacy?' A cold smile curled at the corner of his lips: 'Or perhaps, you also need this Tianji Record Fragment of mine to accomplish some unknown purpose?'

text.content: At that moment, a pressure surpassing all existence descended from the nine heavens. It was an indescribable oppression, as if the entire heavens and earth were bowing to this force. Chen Xuan's remnant soul changed color dramatically, fear and resolve flickering in those soul flames—'It has come!'

dialogue.content: A cold voice echoed across heaven and earth, devoid of emotion, devoid of warmth, yet carrying an overwhelming majesty—'Chen Xuan, ten thousand years have passed, yet you still refuse to rest?' Before the words even finished, a massive eye phantom appeared above the ruins. The eye was entirely golden, its pupil swirling with countless mysterious runes, each rune representing a destiny under its control.

text.content: The Heavenly Eye's phantom slowly rotated, a beam of light shooting from its pupil directly onto Chen Ji. In that moment, Chen Ji felt as if all his disguises had been stripped away, the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea trembling violently, emitting mournful wails. 'Another destiny seed.' A hint of playfulness colored the Heavenly Eye's voice, 'Interesting, weaker than Chen Xuan was back then, yet more potential.'

dialogue.content: Chen Xuan's remnant soul blocked before Chen Ji, his voice hoarse yet firm: 'This lifetime, I will never let you succeed!' He erupted with a brilliant light—that was all the power he had accumulated over ten thousand years of burning. The light rushed toward the Heavenly Eye's phantom, and in an instant, the entire ruins were illuminated as bright as day. 'Go! Take the fragment and leave!' Chen Xuan's voice exploded in Chen Ji's mind, 'Remember, the shackle fragment is your only hope—do not repeat my mistakes!'

text.content: Chen Ji gripped the shackle fragment tightly, gazing at the magnificent scene of Chen Xuan's remnant soul sacrificing its life to resist the Heavenly Eye. An unprecedented shock surged in his heart. This ancestor he had never met, in order to break the shackles, had not hesitated to burn his remnant soul to protect him until now. In this moment, Chen Ji made his own choice.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji turned sharply, darting toward the depths of the ruins. Behind him, Chen Xuan's remnant soul was engaged in a final battle with the Heavenly Eye's phantom. Between the intersecting lights, he faintly caught Chen Xuan's final words—'The true secret of the Tianji Record lies not in recording, but in... rewriting...' The voice cut off abruptly.

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his teeth and ran wildly, repeatedly chewing over Chen Xuan's final words in his heart. Rewriting—so the true use of the Tianji Record was not to record fate, but to rewrite it! Just then, a breath connected to Chen Ji's bloodline suddenly came from the depths of the ruins. The breath was so familiar it made his whole body shudder—it was his sister who had been missing for years, Chen Nian! 【System Prompt: Destiny Twin Resonance Detected】 【Shackle Rule Rewrite Complete】 【Heavenly Fate Value Consumption Mode Changed: Defeating destiny-related targets grants Heavenly Fate Value】

At the same time, a deafening roar echoed from the depths of the ruins. A mighty Demonic Path aura surged forward like a tide, mixed with the killing intent of thousands of troops. The commander of the Demonic Path army had arrived. Chen Ji's steps halted—the missing sister lay ahead, while the Heavenly Eye's remnant pursued from behind. At the crossroads of destiny, he had to make a choice—And at this moment, a familiar figure appeared within his spiritual sense. Su Qingyao—that woman who had been investigating his identity all along, was standing alone in the ruins' depths, confronting the Demonic Path vanguard.

choice.prompt: A dual choice of destiny lay before Chen Ji—his sister who had been missing for years was right ahead, while Su Qingyao was in peril. He had to make a choice—

choices.description: Sister Chen Nian had been missing for years, one more moment wouldn't matter. But if Su Qingyao fell, he would lose his greatest support in the Tianqing Sect, and also lose someone who truly understood him, who tried to comprehend him.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily set aside the trail of searching for his sister
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao's affection increased significantly, may unlock prerequisite conditions for 'Shared Destiny'
choices.risk_hint: Sister may vanish from sight again
choices.process_label: 优先救援陷入危机的苏青瑶

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate in the slightest, his figure turning sharply as he dashed toward where Su Qingyao was. When he arrived, Su Qingyao was single-handedly fending off attacks from three Demonic Path vanguards. Her garments were soaked in blood, yet the sword in her hand remained sharp and unmatched. The strength of an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow was displayed most brilliantly in this moment. 'Chen Ji? What are you doing here?' Surprise and complexity flickered in Su Qingyao's eyes as she saw him.

choices.description: His sister was his obsession for coming to this world, and also his only weakness. Years of searching had finally yielded a clue—no matter what, he couldn't give up.
choices.visible_cost: Su Qingyao may be severely injured or fall, losing an important ally.
choices.visible_reward: Obtained crucial clues about his sister Chen Nian, possibly uncovering more mysteries of his origins.
choices.risk_hint: If Su Qingyao falls, Chen Ji will lose his footing in the Tianqing Sect.
choices.process_label: 追随血脉共鸣寻找失踪的妹妹

text.content:
Chen Ji gritted his teeth, enduring the torment in his heart as he sprinted toward the blood-connected aura.

Passing through layers of labyrinthine corridors, he finally saw that long-missed figure in a hidden stone chamber—Chen Nian lay quietly upon an altar, surrounded by countless golden chains whose aura bore an uncanny resemblance to the Tianji Record.

"Sister!" Chen Ji rushed forward, only to find those chains radiating scalding light, keeping him at bay.

In the moment of Chen Ji's hesitation, a black shadow burst from the darkness, targeting Su Qingyao's heart. It was a Demonic Path death warrior, shrouded in dense death energy, clearly coming with a death wish.

Su Qingyao was locked in combat with two enemies before her, utterly unable to attend to what lay behind.

"Watch out!" Chen Ji shouted sharply, his flying sword leaving his hand and repelling the death warrior at the critical moment.

Su Qingyao seized the chance to turn, slashing down and severing the death warrior's head. Blood gushed forth, splashing across her face, yet it did not affect her composure in the slightest. She gazed at Chen Ji, her expression complex and difficult to decipher.

"Chen Ji... no, what should I call you?" Su Qingyao's voice was soft, carrying an indefinable emotion. "The废物 disciple? The inheritor of the Tianji Record? Or... Chen Xuan's successor?"

She had long investigated information related to Chen Xuan's legacy, and now piecing everything together, her gaze toward Chen Ji held new understanding.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji slowly retracted his flying sword, meeting Su Qingyao's gaze. In that moment, he swiftly weighed the advantages and disadvantages.

Su Qingyao was infinitely close to the truth, and continued concealment was pointless. Moreover, given her personality, since she had chosen to confront him directly, it meant she had already formed her own judgment.

"Which answer does Senior Sister Su wish to hear?" Chen Ji's lips curved slightly, revealing an ambiguous smile. "I am the废物 disciple, I am the Tianji Record inheritor, and Chen Xuan's successor... from today onward, I am also that."

text.content:
Su Qingyao gazed at Chen Ji. This man she once deemed worthless now exuded a charisma she had never witnessed before—a composure refined through vicissitudes, a serenity transcending worldly affairs, and an unwavering resolve to face the Heavenly Dao.

"What do you intend to do?" Su Qingyao sheathed her long sword, her voice low. "The Heavenly Eye... that is an existence even past Sect Masters dared not mention. You wish to oppose it?"

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji offered no reply, instead raising the shackle fragment in his hand. The jet-black fragment glistened with an icy gleam under the dim light, its surface patterns writhing slowly like living things.

"Ancestor Chen Xuan spent ten thousand years laying this chess game, only to create this sliver of opportunity for future generations." Chen Ji's voice was soft, yet carried unshakeable resolve. "If I do not accept, I would be betraying his sacrifice."

He turned to gaze into the depths of the ruins, his vision profound: "Besides... I have reasons I cannot afford to lose."

text.content:
Su Qingyao fell silent for a moment, then suddenly let out a light laugh. That laughter no longer held her usual coldness and distance, replaced instead by relief and recognition.

"As expected of you." She said, "From the moment you made Han Lie lose all face at the Sect Competition, I knew you were no ordinary man. I simply didn't expect... your ambitions to reach such heights."

She stepped forward, standing shoulder to shoulder with Chen Ji: "Chen Ji, I Su Qingyao am not one who lacks discretion. Since the Heavenly Eye is our common enemy, then from now on, I shall advance and retreat with you."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji raised an eyebrow, looking at Su Qingyao with some surprise. This aloof Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, who had probed him endlessly in ordinary times, was now taking the initiative to propose an alliance.

"Senior Sister Su is not afraid I might become a second Chen Xuan, meeting the same fate?"

Su Qingyao冷哼ed coldly: "If you were truly a second Chen Xuan, you wouldn't be wasting words here with me." Her gaze fell upon the shackle fragment in Chen Ji's hand. "You never do anything without certainty, do you?"

text.content:
Chen Ji and Su Qingyao exchanged a knowing smile, everything understood without words.

At this moment, another tremor came from the depths of the ruins. The aura of the Demonic Path army drew ever closer, and amidst the cacophony of battle cries, countless dark shadows could be seen darting through the corridors.

Chen Ji's expression turned grave: "The Demonic Path army's commander has entered the ruins' core. If I猜得不错, Ye Qing should be among them."

He looked at Su Qingyao: "Senior Sister Su, there may be a fierce battle ahead. Are you prepared?"

Su Qingyao gripped her long sword tightly, a flicker of battle intent flashing in her eyes: "Demonic Path riffraff—why would I Su Qingyao fear them?"

Before the words even faded, a black shadow descended from the sky, landing steadily before the two of them. It was a woman dressed in black纱, her features breathtaking yet carrying a hint of妖异, her purple eyes swirling with uncanny light.

Ye Qing—the Demonic Path Holy Maiden—had finally made her appearance.

Her gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a moment, the corner of her lips curving into a meaningful smile: "Chen Gongzi, we meet again. It seems our collaboration shall begin ahead of schedule."

From the depths of the ruins, the Demonic Path army commander's aura pressed down like a mountain, while Chen Nian connected to Chen Ji by blood awaited him somewhere—the gears of destiny had already begun to spin faster.
